title: NuGet Security
description: Secure your .NET dependencies and package management workflow.

data.text:
**NuGet Security**

NuGet packages can introduce vulnerabilities, typosquatting risks, and supply-chain attacks.

items: Use package signatures to verify authenticity
Audit packages with dotnet list package --vulnerable
Remove unused packages to reduce attack surface
Private feeds: restrict access with tokens

data.title: Audit Vulnerabilities
data.content:
dotnet list package --vulnerable --include-transitive

# Output example:
Project `MyApp` has the following vulnerable packages
   [net8.0]:
   Top-level Package   Requested   Resolved   Severity   Advisory
   > Newtonsoft.Json   13.0.1      13.0.1     High       CVE-2024-21890

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: A clean dependency tree is easier to secure and monitor.
